capabilities: Show freshness status dots and last-modified times for watched files
Count unchecked task items in watched files
Check whether today's daily log exists and when it was last written
Warn when the daily log was written well after the handoff file
Open a watched file by clicking its row
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition or flashcard memory tool; it monitors file freshness, mainly for vaults maintained by AI assistants.
extras: Read-only, no network or telemetry; the panel stays empty until files are added in settings. Manual installation from releases or building from source with Node.js is required.
problem: Obsidian gives no at-a-glance way to see whether files that must be kept up to date, such as session summaries or daily logs, have fallen behind.
summary: Sidebar panel that shows how fresh watched memory, handoff and daily log files are, with open task counts and a handoff warning.
